groupings.title: Architecture
groupings.description: Portable, framework-agnostic frontend architecture conventions for React and React Native.

groupings.title: SEO
groupings.description: Portable, framework-agnostic SEO system: centralized identity, canonical URLs, metadata, sitemap/robots/RSS, and typed JSON-LD structured data.

groupings.title: Performance
groupings.description: Portable, framework-agnostic Lighthouse CI performance gate: Core Web Vitals budgets and category score floors enforced as a blocking PR check.

groupings.title: Data Layer
groupings.description: Portable, framework-agnostic data-layer craft: a typed network boundary (parse-don't-validate, one envelope, one error type, branded IDs) and the optimistic-mutation write path (snapshot/rollback, idempotency, cache coherence).

groupings.title: Observability
groupings.description: Portable, framework-agnostic field-side observability: a typed event taxonomy, best-effort provider fan-out, real-user Core Web Vitals, error reporting, and consent gating.
